name: BoxBrownie
positioning: Listing images fixed, staged and decluttered overnight, priced per image.
description: BoxBrownie provides property image editing services: photo enhancement, day-to-dusk conversion, virtual staging, item removal, virtual renovation, floor plan redraws and 360 virtual tours, delivered as a per-image service with overnight turnaround.
real_estate_use: An empty apartment photographs badly and a cluttered one photographs worse. Virtual staging costs a fraction of physical staging and can be ordered the evening before a listing goes live. Virtual renovation is used to show a buyer what a tired property could become — with the disclosure obligations that most markets now attach to edited images.

use_cases.job: Stage an empty property for photography at a fraction of physical staging cost
Show a buyer the renovation potential of a tired property
